comments.overrides: eslint-plugin-import@2.32.0 (latest) still declares a peer range of eslint <=9, which breaks `npm install` against our eslint ^10. The plugin itself works correctly under eslint 10 (`npm run lint` passes), so this override relaxes the peer declaration to match our installed eslint. Remove it once eslint-plugin-import publishes a release supporting eslint 10.
comments.overrides.mongodb: mongoose@9.12.2 pins mongodb ~7.8 and mongodb-memory-server-core@11.3.0 pins ~7.5.0; both ranges contain only vulnerable releases (CVE-2026-119179, CVE-2026-126835, CVE-2026-126837, fixed in 7.9.0). Force the latest mongodb 7.x (same major, no breaking changes). Remove once upstream ranges include >=7.9.0.
comments.overrides.nodemon: nodemon@3.1.14 (latest) depends on minimatch ^10.2.1, and every 10.x release is affected by GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (fixed in 11.0.1). nodemon only calls minimatch(file, pattern, { nocase, windowsPathsNoEscape }), which is unchanged in 11 (only makeRe, debug and internal methods were removed). Remove once nodemon depends on minimatch >=11.0.1.
